summary: Create a symbolic link while preserving Node target text, destination semantics, and Windows type behavior.

semantics.target: stored link target text may be relative
semantics.type: null by default; Node may auto-detect target type, with Windows-specific junction/file/dir handling

caveats: C# symbolic-link APIs have platform and privilege differences.
Normalizing a relative target before link creation changes semantics.
Existing destination should raise Node-compatible error rather than silently overwrite.

tests.name: relative target stored
tests.expected_behavior: creates a link whose stored target is ../t
